+# The rows one verify / batch window holds (include/strata/kernels/window_limits.hpp): 8, the 0.2.7 window, or 16 (four pipelined
+# groups of 16 slots = 64 slots on a four-card split, docs/BATCHING.md).  Only the CUDA and HIP engines are built from
+# these sources with a wide window; the SYCL and Metal builds never read this variable and keep 8.  A window of up to
+# 8 rows runs the kernels it always ran, whichever is chosen (the wide instantiations are extra code).  "auto" = 16 for
+# the HIP engines (a HIP code object loads on first use, so the extra kernels cost nothing until a wide window forms)
+# and 8 for CUDA, which loads every kernel at start (CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER: the wide kernels would take VRAM from
+# the expert cache of every card); -DSTRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T=16 builds the wide CUDA engine.
+set(STRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T "auto" CACHE STRING "rows of a verify / batch window: 8, 16 or auto (HIP 16, CUDA 8)")
+set_property(CACHE STRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T PROPERTY STRINGS auto 8 16)
+if(NOT STRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T STREQUAL "auto" AND NOT STRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T STREQUAL "8" AND NOT STRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T STREQUAL "16")
+  message(FATAL_ERROR "STRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T must be auto, 8 or 16 (got '${STRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T}')")
+endif()
+if(STRATA_ENABLE_HIP OR STRATA_ENABLE_CUDA)
+  if(STRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T STREQUAL "auto")
+    if(STRATA_ENABLE_HIP)
+      set(_strata_window_max_t 16)
+    else()
+      set(_strata_window_max_t 8)
+    endif()
+  else()
+    set(_strata_window_max_t ${STRATA_WINDOW_MAX_T})
+  endif()
+  add_compile_definitions(STRATA_VERIFY_MAX_T=${_strata_window_max_t})
+  message(STATUS "Strata: verify / batch windows hold up to ${_strata_window_max_t} rows")
+endif()

+"""The serving profile of a four-card AMD box: 4 x Radeon AI PRO R9700 (32 GB, gfx1201) running Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S.
+
+Measured on that box (docs/BATCHING.md, "Four R9700 cards: the serving profile"): the cards hold the whole model, so what limits
+them is how many requests decode together and how the four stages are fed, not memory.  The profile sets
+
+* 32 slots in 4 pipelined groups (one group per card), instead of the launcher's 4 requests at a time;
+* the layer split 13,26,39: the output head costs about four layers on the last card, so it gets 9 layers and the others 13;
+* a 2048-token prompt chunk: a smaller chunk reads long prompts faster beside the decodes of the other slots;
+* the three batch switches STRATA_QSA_SLOTS, STRATA_BATCH_SELF_COMMIT and STRATA_SLOT_COPY_DIRECT, which change how the work is
+  scheduled and copied, not what is computed (tools/batch_test.py: every slot decodes the tokens it decodes alone).
+
+Recommend, never force: a setting the person made (the config, `--parallel`, `--layer-split`, an advanced flag, an environment
+variable) always wins, the profile only fills what is not set, and `STRATA_FOUR_CARD_PROFILE=0` (or "four_card_profile": false in
+the run config) turns it off.  Only this hardware class is touched; every other computer gets exactly what it got before.
+
+Pure functions, no I/O (the callers pass the cards and the run config).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+PARALLEL = 32                     # slots (requests decoding together)
+GROUPS = 4                        # pipelined groups: one per card
+LAYER_SPLIT = "13,26,39"          # Qwen3.8-Flash-Next has 48 layers: 13 / 13 / 13 / 9 (the output head sits on the last card)
+PREFILL_CHUNK = "2048"
+BATCH_ENV = {"STRATA_QSA_SLOTS": "1", "STRATA_BATCH_SELF_COMMIT": "1", "STRATA_SLOT_COPY_DIRECT": "1"}
+PROMPT_CACHE_OFF = False          # --prompt-cache 0 is not part of the default: see docs/BATCHING.md
+MIN_CARD_GB = 28.0                # a 32 GB card reports a little less than its name
+CARDS = 4
+OFF_VALUES = ("0", "off", "no", "false")
+
+
+def disabled(cfg: dict | None = None) -> bool:
+    """The person turned the profile off: STRATA_FOUR_CARD_PROFILE=0 in the environment, or "four_card_profile": false in the config."""
+    if str(os.environ.get("STRATA_FOUR_CARD_PROFILE", "")).strip().lower() in OFF_VALUES:
+        return True
+    return bool(cfg) and cfg.get("four_card_profile") is False
+
+
+def card_class(cards: list[dict]) -> bool:
+    """Exactly four AMD cards of one kind, each with at least MIN_CARD_GB: the Radeon AI PRO R9700 (the 32 GB gfx12 card this was
+    measured on)."""
+    if len(cards) != CARDS:
+        return False
+    names = {str(c.get("name") or "") for c in cards}
+    if len(names) != 1 or "R9700" not in next(iter(names)).upper().replace(" ", ""):
+        return False
+    return all(str(c.get("vendor") or "amd").lower() == "amd" and float(c.get("vram_gb") or 0.0) >= MIN_CARD_GB for c in cards)
+
+
+def model_ok(cfg: dict) -> bool:
+    """The measured model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at IQ3_S (48 layers; the pack that fits whole on four 32 GB cards)."""
+    text = " ".join([str(cfg.get("model_name") or "")] + [str(a) for a in cfg.get("args") or []]).lower().replace("-", "_").replace(".", "_")
+    return "qwen3_8" in text and "iq3_s" in text
+
+
+def applies(cards: list[dict], cfg: dict) -> bool:
+    args = [str(a) for a in cfg.get("args") or []]
+    return (not disabled(cfg)) and card_class(cards) and cfg.get("backend", "hip") == "hip" and model_ok(cfg) \
+        and "--peer-device" not in args and not cfg.get("replicas") and cfg.get("arch") != "deepseek41"
+
+
+def apply(cards: list[dict], cfg: dict, *, parallel_given: bool = False) -> list[str]:
+    """Fill the profile into the run config `cfg` (in place) where the person has not chosen; returns the plain lines to show.
+    `parallel_given`: the person named a number of requests (--parallel): then only the split, the chunk and the switches are
+    filled (the engine groups the slots itself)."""
+    if not applies(cards, cfg):

+    args = [str(a) for a in cfg.get("args") or []]
+    env = dict(cfg.get("env") or {})

+        notes.append(f"{PARALLEL} requests at once in {GROUPS} groups, one group per card (--parallel N changes it)")

+"""The oldest NVIDIA driver the CUDA 12 engine package runs on, taken from the package's own metadata (#4247, #4188).
+
+Setup used to say "the CUDA 12 engine works from driver 528 (525 on Linux)", a number copied from NVIDIA's minor-version-compatibility table,
+while the signed feed's cuda12 packages (built with CUDA 12.9) carry `min_driver` 575.51 / 576.02 and `strata update` refuses them below
+that: a PC on driver 556 was told its engine would work and then told the feed had no engine for it. The floor is now read from
+the package that would run:
+
+1. an installed cuda12 package of this platform (the components folder, setup's own engine-feed folder): its manifest's `min_driver`;
+2. else the signed feed (best effort, a few seconds, never an error): the newest cuda12 package of this platform;
+3. else FALLBACK, the figure the shipped packages carry today (packaging/ENGINE-COMPONENT.md).
+
+Nothing here refuses anything: the callers say the number, and say where it came from.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+
+#: What the cuda12 packages carry (packaging/ENGINE-COMPONENT.md: min_driver nvidia 575.51). Only used when no package or feed can be read.
+FALLBACK = "575.51"
+VARIANT = "cuda12"
+FEED_SECONDS = 10.0
+
+
+def major(version: str | None) -> int:
+    """The leading number of a driver version ("576.02" -> 576); 0 when there is none."""
+    try:
+        return int(str(version or "").strip().split(".")[0])
+    except ValueError:
+        return 0
+
+
+def _key(version: str) -> tuple:
+    return tuple(int(p) if p.isdigit() else 0 for p in str(version).replace("-", ".").split("."))
+
+
+def _floor_of(packages, platform: str, variant: str):
+    """The `min_driver` (nvidia) of the newest package of `variant` for `platform`: items with .version, .platform, .backend, .variant, .min_driver."""
+    best = None
+    for item in packages:
+        if item.backend != "cuda" or item.variant != variant or (platform and item.platform != platform):
+            continue
+        need = (item.min_driver or {}).get("nvidia")
+        if not need or not major(need):
+            continue
+        if best is None or _key(item.version) > _key(best.version):
+            best = item
+    return None if best is None else str(best.min_driver["nvidia"])
+
+
+def installed(roots, platform: str, variant: str = VARIANT) -> str | None:
+    """The floor of a cuda12 package already on this PC, from its manifest (no network)."""
+    from strata_control import engine_component as ec
+    found = []
+    for root in roots or ():
+        try:
+            components, _problems = ec.scan(Path(root))
+        except Exception:                                # noqa: BLE001 - a folder that cannot be read has no answer
+            continue
+        found.extend(components)
+    return _floor_of(found, platform, variant)
+
+
+def from_feed(source: str, platform: str, variant: str = VARIANT, *, seconds: float = FEED_SECONDS) -> str | None:
+    """The floor the signed feed gives a cuda12 package of this platform; None when the feed cannot be read in `seconds` (offline, no key,
+    a feed with no such package). Runs the read on a thread so a hung connection never holds setup up."""
+    answer: list = []

+    args, note = plan(cfg.get("args"), cfg.get("user_args"), cards, mtp_off=cfg.get("mtp") is False)

+    return note

+B70 = {"driver": "xe", "devid": "e223"}
+B50 = {"driver": "xe", "devid": "e212"}
+B580 = {"driver": "xe", "devid": "e20b"}
+A770 = {"driver": "xe", "devid": "56a0"}

+    assert not intel_spec.is_battlemage("i915", "e223")      # the driver decides too
+    assert not intel_spec.is_battlemage("xe", "64a0")        # an integrated Xe2 part is not a B-series card

+class DiscoverRunConfigCase(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-discover-")
+        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
+        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
+
+    def config(self, name: str, **fields) -> str:
+        path = self.root / f"strata-{name}.json"
+        path.write_text(json.dumps(fields), encoding="utf-8")
+        return str(path)
+
+    def discover(self, *entries):
+        listed = {"models": [{"id": i, "component_status": "present", "source_config": c} for i, c in entries]}
+        with mock.patch.object(models, "list_installed", return_value=listed), \
+                mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.list_profiles", return_value=[]):
+            return updater.discover_run_config()

+        deep = self.config("deepseek", exe="C:/e/engine-dsv41/0.1.51/strata-dsv41.exe", arch="deepseek41", args=["--eos", "1"])
+        qwen = self.config("qwen", exe="C:/e/engine/strata.exe", args=["--pack", "x"])
+        # "deepseek..." sorts first by id, which is how the update picked it before
+        self.assertEqual(self.discover(("deepseek-v4.1-flash", deep), ("unsloth-ud-iq4_xs", qwen)), Path(qwen))
